answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 24538 Country: Pakistan Title: I would like to know that is it true that by reading bismillah 786 times and making a dua then that dua will come true/be accepted.? Question: I would like to know that is it true that by reading bismillah 786 times and making a dua then that dua will come true/be accepted.? Answer ID: 24538 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1452/1130/B=1431) This practice is reported by our elders and dua is accepted. Moreover, if it is blown on water after reciting in the said numbers and given to drink, he or she shall be cured. It will increase love between spouses. It is very elixir for many things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
